description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams for filtering employee reports in the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends a date range filter class, adds employee and project-specific filtering attributes, and includes constants for allowed sorting and timesheet inclusion options.

classes.name: EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object to capture search filter parameters for employee reports, including employee number, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion options.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID used in the filter, if any.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID for the filter.

methods.name: getActivityId
methods.description: Returns the activity ID used in the filter, if any.

methods.name: setActivityId
methods.description: Sets the activity ID for the filter.

methods.name: setIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Sets the timesheets inclusion option, validating against allowed values.
